paper: Fin-Analyst at FinMMEval 2026 Task 3: A Live Hybrid Trading Agent with LLM Specialists and Rule-Based Signals
claim_boundary: A researcher-authored monthly cross-sectional U.S.-stock analogue of the paper's TSLA branch: eight data-specific specialists plus the recency-weighted Meta-Agent, explicit BUY/HOLD/SELL verdicts, news override, majority rule, and HOLD fallback; not the native gpt-4o-mini calls, corpora, TSLA actions, or organizer path.

primary_source_anchors.mechanism: The TSLA branch loads persistent signal corpora, invokes eight role-conditioned specialists, and passes their action/confidence/reasoning records to a Meta-Agent.
News, Event, Quarterly, Annual, Fundamentals, Analyst, Technical, and Social specialists encode source-specific directional rules and confidence conventions.
News has highest recency weight and can override above 0.70 confidence; agreement by at least five specialists is followed strongly, and HOLD is reserved for a genuinely split panel.
Every specialist emits JSON action/confidence/reasoning, unchanged low-frequency cards may reuse cached verdicts, and an exception becomes HOLD under the no-retry protocol.

meta_agent_policy.continuous_portfolio_score: override score, majority-signed agreeing strength, or weighted specialist sum before the final discrete action
meta_agent_policy.common_portfolio_adapter: the continuous Meta-Agent score enters fixed value-weighted long-short deciles and all six common paths

approximated_elements: point-in-time JKP characteristics replace the seven native corpora and daily news bundle
signed rank composites replace gpt-4o-mini specialist reasoning
accounting surprises replace news, 8-K, 10-Q, and analyst text
quality/value characteristics replace the 10-K and Compustat cards
turnover and extreme-return characteristics replace WSB sentiment
monthly momentum and volatility replace MACD/RSI/BB/ADX
continuous cross-sectional scores replace single-TSLA daily actions
common 10 bp decile execution replaces the organizer single-asset scorer
invented_elements: the exact signed JKP mapping for each specialist
the catalyst gate paired with the 0.70 news override
